name: Chamber
author: Erin Carter
description: The three-mirror tube seen as wallpaper: a real kaleidoscope's triangular mirror chamber tiles the whole plane with reflected copies of one triangle, so the frame fills edge-to-edge with a repeating jewelled honeycomb instead of a single radial star. Coloured glass motes drift through the fundamental triangle while the lattice slowly slides and turns; cut-glass glints run the mirror seams.

params.label: Tiling
params.effect: How many reflected triangles span the frame — low for big bold cells, high for a fine mosaic.

params.label: Drift
params.effect: Rate the glass motes breathe toward and away from each triangle's centre, pulsing the honeycomb.

params.label: Turn
params.effect: Speed the whole lattice rotates; at 0 the wallpaper only breathes.

params.label: Glow
params.effect: Overall strength of the glass glow and seam glints.
